targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time, split_part(unit, '|', 2) AS metric, metric_value AS value FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name LIKE 'syno_disk_temp.%' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp

WITH latest AS (SELECT metric_name, metric_value, unit, split_part(metric_name, '.', 2) AS idx, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY metric_name ORDER BY timestamp DESC) rn FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name ~ '^syno_disk_(status|temp)\.' AND timestamp > now() - interval '20 min') SELECT split_part(MAX(unit) FILTER (WHERE metric_name LIKE 'syno_disk_status%'), '|', 2) AS "Disk", MAX(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name LIKE 'syno_disk_status%') AS "Status", MAX(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name LIKE 'syno_disk_temp%') AS "Temp C" FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY idx ORDER BY 1

WITH latest AS (SELECT metric_name, metric_value, unit, split_part(metric_name, '.', 2) AS idx, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY metric_name ORDER BY timestamp DESC) rn FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name ~ '^syno_raid_(total|free)_bytes\.' AND timestamp > now() - interval '20 min') SELECT split_part(MAX(unit), '|', 2) AS metric, CASE WHEN MAX(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name LIKE '%total%') > 0 THEN 100.0 * (MAX(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name LIKE '%total%') - MAX(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name LIKE '%free%')) / MAX(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name LIKE '%total%') ELSE 0 END AS value FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY idx ORDER BY 1

WITH latest AS (SELECT metric_name, metric_value, unit, split_part(metric_name, '.', 2) AS idx, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY metric_name ORDER BY timestamp DESC) rn FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name ~ '^syno_raid_(status|total_bytes|free_bytes)\.' AND timestamp > now() - interval '20 min') SELECT split_part(MAX(unit) FILTER (WHERE metric_name LIKE 'syno_raid_status%'), '|', 2) AS "Volume", MAX(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name LIKE 'syno_raid_status%') AS "Status", MAX(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name LIKE '%total%') AS "Total", MAX(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name LIKE '%free%') AS "Free" FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY idx ORDER BY 1

SELECT u.timestamp AS time, u.device_name || ' ' || COALESCE(d.unit, u.metric_name) AS metric, CASE WHEN s.metric_value > 0 THEN 100.0 * u.metric_value / s.metric_value ELSE 0 END AS value FROM snmp_metrics u JOIN snmp_metrics s ON s.device_name = u.device_name AND s.timestamp = u.timestamp AND s.metric_name = 'disk_storage_size.' || split_part(u.metric_name, '.', 2) LEFT JOIN snmp_metrics d ON d.device_name = u.device_name AND d.metric_name = 'disk_storage_descr.' || split_part(u.metric_name, '.', 2) AND d.timestamp = u.timestamp WHERE u.metric_name LIKE 'disk_storage_used.%' AND s.metric_value > 0 AND $__timeFilter(u.timestamp) ORDER BY u.timestamp
